verdict.rationale: Orama's docs describe hybrid search as performing full-text and vector search in one unique query and combining the results (orama-docs-5). The GitHub README lists it as a core feature, Orama Cloud offers it as a search mode, and the embeddings plugin generates vectors at insert and search time to enable it. Missing for 10: details on how results are fused or weighted (e.g., tunable keyword/vector weights) and independent or hands-on corroboration.
